reason: Honestly the pay-when-happy bit and the £43 cancel-any-month plan answer my usual worry about monthly costs, but I've had three designers chasing me this month and this one is a single person in Kuwait with no UK clients or reviews. I want someone who'll just handle it for years, and I can't tell if he'll still be around or answer quickly when something breaks on a Saturday.
objection: If it's just one bloke abroad and he disappears or gets busy, I'm left with a site nobody's looking after and I'm the one who has to sort it, which is exactly what I'm paying to avoid.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of real UK business owners I could ring or read reviews from, saying he built their site and still answers within the day.
